title.en: Arabic-Indic and Persian digits work in every command

goal.en: Phones set to an Arabic or Persian keyboard send different digit characters. The grammar accepts them wherever a digit may appear, in quantities, temperatures, dates and counts.

note.en: An offer with Arabic-Indic quantity and temperature.
A farm offer with Persian digits in the quantity and the harvest date.

outcome.en: You know a program can run on the phones people already have, in the digits they already type. Next: scenario 002 walks through a full SMS day.
